rationale: The same intraday formulas as the parent protocol, scored once each without search, on a different population: cohort v3, the mid-liquidity band of ranks 401-1,400 of the 2026-10-15 liquidity-screen snapshot, which begins where cohort v2's top cut ends. The universe floor is an absolute 20-session median dollar volume of $5 million (with the $10 price floor) instead of the static percentile, because the static reference set is mega-cap and a percentile of it would be meaningless for this band. The decisive cost is 15 bp rather than 5 bp, reflecting the wider spreads of smaller names. Survivorship caveat: membership is today's, so delisted and shrunken smaller names are absent and results for these names are more optimistic than a point-in-time cohort would give. Checks A and C bind (no search, so check B does not apply); the campaign runs only on operator approval, and the lane-wide confirmation window remains unused until a finalist freezes.
title: Intraday pooled campaign on cohort v3 (mid-liquidity band, ranks 401-1,400): hourly score inputs read at the first completed regular bucket of the decision session, predeclared fixed set of eight intraday formulas (checks A and C), one-shot lane-wide confirmation
